trans-unit.source: Identify the exact inspection, including its re-inspection, by inspectionSystemId. testCode is the test code, not its caption. value is text (maximum 250 characters); an empty string clears it if Microsoft permits. Unknown keys, missing keys, non-text values and overlong values are refused. The inspection must be open and have exactly one matching test line. Microsoft validation and result rules apply. The standard path has no explicit Commit; explicit commits from subscribers are prohibited. Normal execution uses a separate transaction, so a business refusal rolls back all writes. With Omit Commit, the caller owns rollback. Repeating the same value is not guaranteed idempotent because Microsoft validation can update related expressions and invoke subscribers. No external provider is called.
trans-unit.target: Auðkenndu tiltekna skoðun, ásamt endurskoðun hennar, með inspectionSystemId. testCode er prófunarkóði, ekki heiti. value er texti (hámark 250 stafir); tómur strengur hreinsar gildið ef Microsoft leyfir. Óþekktum lyklum, lyklum sem vantar, öðrum gildum en texta og of löngum gildum er hafnað. Skoðunin verður að vera opin og hafa nákvæmlega eina samsvarandi prófunarlínu. Staðfestingar og niðurstöðureglur Microsoft gilda. Staðlaða leiðin inniheldur ekkert beint Commit; beinar staðfestingar frá áskrifendum eru bannaðar. Venjuleg keyrsla notar sérstaka færslu svo höfnun bakfærir allar breytingar. Með Omit Commit ber kallandi ábyrgð á bakfærslu. Endurtekning sama gildis tryggir ekki óbreytt ástand því staðfesting Microsoft getur uppfært tengdar segðir og kallað á áskrifendur. Engin ytri þjónusta er kölluð.

Microsoft requires positive failed quantity, sufficient received quantity and valid purchase setup. No explicit Commit occurs on the standard disposition path; explicit subscriber commits are prohibited. Normal execution rolls back all writes on refusal. With Omit Commit the caller owns rollback. This operation is not idempotent: a retry can create another return. It creates an unposted return order; it does not post a vendor credit memo or call an external provider.

trans-unit.source: Calls FinishInspection on the quality inspection header. That procedure checks item tracking, then validates Status to Finished, which checks that the result allows finishing, records the finish user and timestamp, and modifies the header. It does not write Status on its own. FinishInspection does not call Commit. Unless the caller set Omit Commit, this message runs that call inside Codeunit.Run, which commits when finishing succeeds. A configured inspection-finished workflow can also commit inside Business Central. Finishing an inspection that is already finished does not write again when the item-tracking check passes.
trans-unit.target: Kallar FinishInspection á haus gæðaskoðunar. Aðgerðin athugar vörurekjanleika og staðfestir síðan Status sem Finished, sem athugar hvort niðurstaðan leyfi að ljúka, skráir notanda og tímastimpil og breytir hausnum. Skilaboðin skrifa ekki Status sjálf. FinishInspection kallar ekki Commit. Nema kallandinn setji Omit Commit keyra skilaboðin kallið innan Codeunit.Run, sem staðfestir færsluna þegar skoðun lýkur. Uppsett verkflæði við lok skoðunar getur einnig staðfest færslu innan Business Central. Engin endurskrifun á sér stað þegar skoðuninni er þegar lokið og athugun vörurekjanleika tekst.

trans-unit.source: FinishInspection asks for confirmation when a user interface is available. A service call has no screen, so Business Central finishes without that question and still runs the checks. When a screen is present and the confirmation is declined, the inspection stays open and this message returns PreconditionFailed. A result configured to disallow finishing, or missing required item tracking, is returned as BusinessCentralError and leaves the inspection unchanged. FinishInspection does not call Commit. Unless Omit Commit is set, Codeunit.Run commits a successful finish. The answer uses status Success and recordStatus for the inspection, because Foundation reserves status for the outcome.
trans-unit.target: FinishInspection biður um staðfestingu þegar notendaviðmót er tiltækt. Þjónustukall hefur engan skjá, svo Business Central lýkur án þessarar spurningar en keyrir samt athuganirnar. Þegar skjár er tiltækur og staðfestingu er hafnað er skoðunin áfram opin og skilaboðin skila PreconditionFailed. Niðurstaða sem bannar að ljúka, eða nauðsynlegur vörurekjanleiki sem vantar, skilar BusinessCentralError og skilur skoðunina eftir óbreytta. FinishInspection kallar ekki Commit. Nema Omit Commit sé stillt staðfestir Codeunit.Run færsluna þegar skoðun lýkur. Svarið notar status Success og recordStatus fyrir skoðunina því Foundation áskilur status fyrir niðurstöðu skilaboðanna.
trans-unit.note: is-IS=FinishInspection biður um staðfestingu þegar notendaviðmót er tiltækt.
